Last updated: September 17, 2026

The June Group Buy is closed.

Most June GB products have already sh1pped and been delivered.

ELOR@ / 3LORA — LATEST UPDATE

Elor@ was part of the June GB but did not sh1p with the rest because pr0duction was significantly delayed.

The original Elor@ 0rder was being handled by Changsha. Changsha reported that the batch had finally been pr0duced, but its logistics network became unable to move the product and could not provide a reliable sh1pping path before at least after the September 25–October 7 holiday period.

Because Elor@ degrades quickly when not kept frozen, waiting indefinitely for Changsha to regain a viable logistics route was not considered acceptable.

The organizer requested and received a r3fund from Changsha for the Elor@ 0rder.

The June Elor@ fulfillment has now been moved to YuanTai.

YuanTai has secured the necessary Elor@ raws and is pr0ducing the replacement batch.

Sample YuanTai Elor@ k1ts are expected to be tested with expedited lab processing. The organizer intends to obtain COAs for the YuanTai Elor@ before fulfillment and has reported seeing multiple previous provider COAs showing high purity and slight overfill; however, those previous COAs are context only and are NOT substitutes for the COAs for the actual Tegridy batches.

Pending June Elor@ 0rders are being treated as a top-priority fulfillment item and are intended to receive rushed sh1pping once product is available.

YuanTai can pr0duce Elor@ in batches of 1,000 k1ts.

A full COA will be provided for each batch Tegridy receives, and batches will be differentiated so members can identify which COA corresponds to which batch.

The bot cannot process a r3fund or verify an individual 0rder. Members requesting a r3fund for their pending June Elor@ 0rder should contact an admin.
